name: Phreesia
short_description: Phreesia is an enterprise patient intake and engagement platform with digital check-in and payment collection.
long_description: Phreesia is a healthcare technology company providing enterprise-level patient intake, engagement, and payment solutions. The platform digitizes patient check-in, insurance verification, consent forms, and payment collection. Phreesia integrates with major EHR systems and supports multilingual communication. The company serves large healthcare organizations, health systems, and multi-location practices seeking to eliminate paper intake processes and reduce administrative burden. Phreesia is publicly traded and serves millions of patient interactions annually.
one_liner: Enterprise patient intake and engagement platform with digital check-in.
best_for: Large healthcare organizations needing enterprise patient intake
Practices wanting to eliminate paper intake and reduce errors
Organizations requiring AI-powered multilingual patient communication
Health systems needing deep EHR integration for intake workflows
